verdict.rationale: Poly documents its own search inside files: natural-language search down to the exact page, paragraph, timestamp or frame, automatic indexing, and a `poly search` CLI command. Tags exist via Finder sync, but nothing shows search filtered by tags, properties or paths, and nothing shows offline search. Missing for 10: documented filters on tags/properties/paths, offline search capability, explicit full-text (vs. natural-language) query support, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed.
